q: Find the perimeter of a triangle with sides 5.5cm, 6cm, and 6.5cm.
A triangle's sides are in ratio 13:15:14, and its perimeter is 84cm. Find the sides.
Find the area (m²) of a triangle with sides 15m, 16m, 17m.
An equilateral field of side x has the same area as a triangular field with sides 50m,70m,80m. Find x (nearest).
A triangle has inradius 4cm and perimeter 20cm. Find its area.
A triangle's sides multiply to 2400 cm³, and its circumradius is 12cm. Find the area.
A triangle has area 15cm² and inradius 3cm. Find its perimeter.
A triangle's sides are in ratio 4:5:6, with inradius 3cm. Find the altitude to the longest side.
sol: Solving via Area=r×s and Heron's formula gives altitude=7.5cm

q: A 15m ladder reaches a window 9m up one side of a street. Pivoted at the same base point, it reaches a 12m window on the other side. Find the street's width.
A triangular field has sides 17m,25m,26m. A cow is tied at each corner with a 7m rope. Find the ungrazed area.
sol: Field area=204. Grazed(3 sectors summing to 180°)=77. Ungrazed=204-77=127m²
